scope: Single-thread standalone Cell CPU with fixed 64-block iterative catalogs and the Raytrace-trained context-cut policy in all arms. The neighbor context is the only execution switch.
statistic: One excluded warm-up per arm. Fresh processes with rotated and reversed order, seven measured rounds on sum-bits and four on Raytrace. Separate instrumentation runs have three measured rounds after a warm-up. All durations are milliseconds unless suffixed ns. Rule maintenance is inside query time. Shared publication is outside query time.
